title: Print-in-place hinge
request: Make a print-in-place hinge as two separate bodies that must not touch, laid out flat and open on the print bed. The hinge is 40 mm long along its pin. Along that axis are three knuckles, each 8 mm in diameter and resting on the bed. The first body has the two outer knuckles, each 13 mm long, and a 4 mm pin that runs through all three. The second body has the middle knuckle, bored around the pin. Each body also has a flat leaf, 3 mm thick and lying on the bed, that reaches 25 mm out from the pin's axis, one to each side. Leave 0.4 mm of clearance wherever the two bodies come close: between the knuckles, between the pin and the bore, and between each leaf and the other body's knuckles.

needs.why: two bodies: cad_build passes them only with its bodies argument
